Hi Alice / Mike —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call last week. Wed like to get the hands-on POC working session on the calendar so we can:
- walk through your prompt set and expected routing logic,
- run a short load validation (target: 50–100 concurrent users simulation), and
- validate prefix caching + KV-cache behavior on your sample traffic.

Proposed 90-minute slots (PST):
- Tue Aug 10, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Aug 11, 14:00–15:30
- Thu Aug 12, 09:00–10:30

Agenda (attached: redwood-poc-agenda.pdf):
1) 10m intro + success criteria
2) 25m prompt walkthrough (your prompts + redwood routing)
3) 30m hands-on: run basic workload + observe latency/cost metrics
4) 20m load validation + fallbacks
5) 5m action items & next steps

Pre-reqs (attached: env-checklist.xlsx): please confirm the test API keys, a small sample prompt file (<=500 prompts), and that your infra team can open the test CIDR for our ephemeral runners.

If one of the slots above works, Ill send invites and loop in Olga for the load runbook. If none work, send two options that better match your schedule and well adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to getting hands-on.

—Sean Gallagher

Hi all — great session this morning. Quick recap and owners (short action log below), and Ive included the raw notes from the runbook output for reference.

What we accomplished:
- Walked through ~420 prompts; validated routing mapping (short-chat/transactional/retrieval-assisted).
- Ran a smoke load and stepped to peak (75 concurrent simulated users). No hard SLO breaches; a few tail latency spikes on retrieval-assisted route.
- Verified prefix KV-cache reduced token compute on repeat queries by ~18% in our sample run.

Action items (owner — due):
1) Tail-latency investigation on retrieval-assisted route — Olga Petrov — due Aug 11 EOD.
2) Prompt tuning for transactional path (reduce generation length on fallback) — Dev Patel — due Aug 10 EOD.
3) Exchange full prompt file + mapping with sanitized PII removed — Alice Chen (KiteScale) — due Aug 06 EOD.
4) Schedule follow-up deep-dive on retrieval strategy (90m) — Marissa Cole — propose dates by Aug 09.

Meeting artifacts:
- Load run output (attached): load-runbook.md (contains stepwise results)
- Screenshots and dashboards uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPocResources

Next session: Marissa will propose 1–2 times for the retrieval deep-dive. Ive tentatively reserved Aug 13 10:00–11:30 PST on our side; please expect an invite once Marissa confirms.

Quick replies:
> Dev Patel: noted, will start prompt tuning today.
> Marissa Cole: Ill send date options by COB Aug 09.

Thanks everyone — excellent collaboration. If anything else comes up, reply-all and well triage.
